newsitem.title: USA: KKR lowers merger terms for Kindercare.
newsitem.headline: KKR lowers merger terms for Kindercare.

text.p: Kindercare Learning Centres Inc. and Kohlberg Kravis Roberts & Co. said the Wall Street buyout firm has lowered the amount it will pay for the nation's largest chain of pre-school and child care centres.
The companies said late Friday that an affiliate of KKR would lower the amount it was paying to $19 per share from $20.25 a share.
The deal was originally worth $600 million including the assumption of debt. The companies were not available to comment on the new value of the offer.
Kindercare said that that the amendment followed an assessment by KKR of KinderCare's recent business performance.
The company operates 1,151 chid centres in 38 states and Britain.
